description: Return the top-N most recent STANDALONE executions of a suite or test case (newest first), as a scoreboard — runId, state, timing, reportUrl, plus a per-test-case tally for SUITE runs (passed/failed/skipped of total). No step-level detail; use `run_status({ runId })` on any row to drill in. Pass EXACTLY one of `suiteId` or `tcId`. `limit` defaults to 5, capped at 20. Suite-child TC rows are excluded from a `tcId` query, so a test case that only runs inside suites returns empty. Requires a live connection.

limit.description: How many recent runs to return (default 5, max 20).

suiteId.description: A suite id (from suite_list) — returns the suite's recent executions.

tcId.description: A test case id — returns the TC's recent STANDALONE executions.

name: run_history
title: Recent execution history for a suite or test case
